clips.title: The story
paras: High in Aldrassil, Tenaron Stormgrip guides young night elves through their people's recent history. He also asks them to gather water from a moonwell.

Tenaron Stormgrip guides young night elves on Aldrassil's winding wooden platforms. From high in Shadowglen's central tree, he watches the local woods and their moonwells. He teaches novices about their spiritual bond with the World Tree.

Tenaron sends initiates to gather a phial of water from the moonwell north of Aldrassil. Along the way, he teaches them what followed the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Their journey carries on through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.
